title: Ubisoft ends game development at Red Storm and lays off 105 workers
content: Ubisoft has announced it is ending game development at Red Storm Entertainment and laying off 105 workers. The studio, known for creating the Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six series, will continue operating in a reduced capacity focused on global IT support and Snowdrop engine support. This move is part of Ubisoft's broader restructuring efforts as the company faces financial pressures and declining game sales. Red Storm was one of Ubisoft's oldest North American studios.
